scope.source: data/records.json confirmed dining experiences plus data/dining-awards-audit.json confirmedArchiveOnly entries not represented as canonical dining records
scope.note: Includes a Jack Stack restaurant-group memory covering as-yet-unidentified branches in addition to its separately confirmed Overland Park location. Excludes J-Bar (cocktail bar, not restaurant) and all unconfirmed interview candidates. Repeated visits to one venue count once.
scope.coverageLimitation: Targeted verified official-source sweep and secondary 5280 discovery index, not an exhaustive audit of historical years. 'Not verified' is not 'never honored'; the 2026 Colorado Michelin list should not be generalized to other years or areas.

rules.formal_michelin_jbf_recognition: Actual Michelin Star, Bib Gourmand, Selected/Recommended, historical Plate or Michelin restaurant-linked special award, or James Beard semifinalist/finalist/winner tied to named restaurant/chef at that venue, with year, tier and primary source. Only this sets editorial.awardQualified=true.
rules.official_program_or_editorial_connection: Named restaurant or team at the visited location appears in an official JBF program/event or Michelin/JBF authored editorial, or a chef at that venue receives an official nonaward feature. Show 'Official Foundation connection', 'Featured by Michelin', or 'JBF program participant' as applicable; never 'award-winner'.
rules.personal_featured_exception: Explicitly user-selected meaningful experiences included without a recognition claim; continue quarterly award watchlist.
rules.archived_pending_recognition: Confirmed personal dining memories with no verified qualifying award or direct official program. Remain private, retained, revisited quarterly.
rules.location: Do not transfer a chef's prior award to their new restaurant, an honor from one branch to another, or a hotel's Michelin listing to a bar inside it.
rules.time: A later recognition or Foundation event is not evidence the restaurant was recognized on the user's meal date.
rules.interview: Maybe/not-visited/reservation-only candidates are excluded from all confirmed totals and curated collection, even if they have official distinctions.

Deep-dive identified documented Sunflower executive-chef alumni Christoph Peherstorfer (2026 Crested Butte Wine + Food Festival participant) and John Leonardi (later Soupçon chef-owner; Soupçon appears in JBF Smart Catch Committed roster), plus sous chef Ian Scott (later Slogar owner). The regional festival's separate Ty Leon/Restaurant Olivia biography references 2025 Michelin service and 2026 JBF hospitality honors, incorrectly attributed to Sunflower by a user-supplied generated screenshot. Official 2025 Michelin service award went to Olivia's Heather Morrison; JBF Outstanding Hospitality 2026 semifinalist was Restaurant Olivia, not finalist or winner. Sunflower itself has independent press and state tourism coverage but no direct official Michelin/JBF link verified. Do not transfer awards or certification across restaurants or people.
